title: Hypothermia

source.name: CDC — Winter Weather: Hypothermia — U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

steps: Get the person out of wind and cold, into shelter if possible.
Remove wet clothing and replace with dry layers.
Warm the center of the body first: chest, neck, head and groin.
Use dry blankets, a sleeping bag, or skin-to-skin contact under loose dry layers.
If the person is alert and can swallow, give warm, sweet, non-alcoholic drinks.
Handle the person gently. Keep them dry and wrapped, including head and neck.
If there is no breathing or pulse, start CPR.
